during the DTO migration without redefining the service payload shape as a request model.

QualityRequest.description:
Flexible quality write payload; validation remains in the quality service.

The quality API accepts heterogeneous per-operation JSON payloads. The DTO makes the request
body a named OpenAPI component (instead of an untyped object) while ``extra="allow"`` preserves
every operation-specific field; route handlers pass ``model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`` to the
unchanged service layer.
QualityRequest.title: QualityRequest

TraceabilityRequest.description:
Flexible storage/status write payload; service validation is unchanged.

Route handlers pass ``model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`` so idempotency fingerprints and service
calls continue to see the same plain mapping as before.
TraceabilityRequest.title: TraceabilityRequest

TraceabilityResponse.description: Storage/status/lot/serial entity or action envelope; unknown service fields are preserved.
TraceabilityResponse.title: TraceabilityResponse
